headlines.title: Bond yields plunge after Treasury announces surprise move to ease rising rates
How grocery prices have changed since Trump took office
headlines.description: Learn where grocery prices stand during the Trump administration. See how inflation is affecting the cost of eggs, bread, chicken, ground beef and more.

headlines.title: China’s backflipping robots leap to blockbuster stock market debut in latest sign of AI boom
headlines.description: Unitree, China’s humanoid robotics firm, saw its shares soar 460% on its Shanghai stock market debut on Wednesday, as investors rally behind homegrown beneficiaries of the A.I. boom.

headlines.title: Trump pauses 50% tariffs on Canada for 3 days, citing a new deal
headlines.description: President Donald Trump late Tuesday slammed the brakes on a wave of tariffs that were set to hit Canada at midnight.

headlines.title: Disney and ABC sue FCC, accusing Trump administration of ‘retaliatory campaign’
headlines.description: The Walt Disney Co. and ABC sued the FCC, seeking to stop an early license renewal process that they say is an attack by the Trump administration.

headlines.title: To Tip or Skip? Consumers Say They’ve Had Enough
headlines.description: While Americans love to reward good service, many are having second thoughts about the barrage of tip requests on practically everything. Restaurant technology platform Popmenu says 40% of consumers are tipping less in 2026 than in 2025 because of tipping fatigue, tighter budgets and rising prices. NBC’s Christine Romans reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Neutrogena faces backlash after death of Hayden Panettiere
headlines.description: The skincare brand Neutrogena is facing backlash over its parting ways with actress Hayden Panettiere a decade ago. The company is facing renewed scrutiny after Panettiere's death at the age of 36, with her comments about her relationship with Neutrogena resurfacing and going viral on social media.

headlines.title: Is it Ok to Max Out Your Credit Card As Long as You Pay it?
headlines.description: There are many misconceptions about credit card payments, balances and credit scores, so NBC’s Christine Romans joins TODAY to set the record straight. She delves into whether cancelling a credit card impacts your score, if carrying a balance helps you build credit, and more.

headlines.title: Why Mid-August Is the Perfect Time to Book a Group Trip
headlines.description: The end of summer is a great time to squeeze in one more trip with family and friends, as prices tend to drop mid-August. NBC’s Christine Romans joins TODAY with tips, including ways to split expenses, sorting out responsibilities among the group and more.

headlines.title: Gov. Josh Shapiro takes a hard line against ‘predatory’ data center developers in Pennsylvania
headlines.description: Shapiro, a potential Democratic 2028 contender, earlier welcomed data center developments. His new executive order takes a starkly different tone toward the industry.

headlines.title: Lakers controlling owner Jeanie Buss hasn’t agreed to sell share of team, lawyer says
headlines.description: Her lawyer also accused Joey and Jesse Buss of leaking “false, defamatory and pernicious ‘information.’”

headlines.title: Oil jumps past $91 as Trump casts doubt on a new deal with Iran
headlines.description: The president said the critical Strait of Hormuz was “open,” but the latest shipping traffic data didn’t appear to support his claim.
